packages.label: רוּחַ אֱלֹקִים וְהַמַּנְהִיג הָאֱמִתִּי
packages.label_en: Divine Spirit and the True Leader
packages.reason: All these concepts share the same essential nature: the Tzaddik who is the true leader (Moses-archetype) IS the universal intellect (מחין), which IS the divine spirit (רוח אלקים), which IS the spirit of holiness and prophecy, which IS the labor of building the Temple. The Rebbe equates every facet of the Tzaddik-as-leader with divine intellect and spirit: 'הרוח אלקים הוא בעצמו המחין.' The leader's gaze ignites each person's intellect because he himself is the universal mind. דעת and מלכות/גדולה are merged here because the text explicitly identifies דעת = בנין בית המקדש = מלאכת המחין, and גדולה/מלכות is distributed by the Tzaddik through his intellect-gaze. חכם הדור = חכם הכולל = מנהיג אמתי = משה are all synonyms for the same role.

merge_notes.reason: חכם הדור and חכם הכולל are declared synonyms of the Tzaddik-as-universal-mind (explicitly: 'שהוא חכם הדור, בחינת חכם הכולל'). Their bechina edge connects them to each other; thematically they are another name for the same reality as מנהיג אמתי = משה. Sharing nature with the Tzaddik cluster.

מלכות = גדולה by explicit bechina ('בחינת המלכות, דהיינו גדולה'). גדולה in this Torah is the greatness distributed by the Tzaddik through his gaze — it is the output of the Tzaddik's intellect-illumination (מלך אסור ברהטים = מלכות is tied to the sparkling of the mind). The bechina pair stands closest to the Tzaddik package since their content is: the Tzaddik grants גדולה = מלכות through intellect. Not cause-effect with this package — rather, גדולה IS a mode of מלכות which IS the domain of the Tzaddik's distribution.

The text states explicitly: 'כל מי שיש בו דעה, כאלו נבנה בית המקדש בימיו, כי עיקר בחינת בנין בית המקדש הוא הדעת.' דעת IS bechina of בנין בית המקדש. This pair belongs to the same domain as מחין = מלאכת בנין בית המקדש. Though they have different node IDs from מחין, they share the same conceptual identity and thematic home.

packages.label: תְּשׁוּבָה וְחַיִּים נִצְחִיִּים
packages.reason: These concepts all share the same essential nature as expressions of the eternal, boundless life that comes through return to God. תשובה IS חיים (eternal life); חיים = חיים נצחיים; חיים נצחיים של עולם הבא = תשובה = שבת; שבת = יראה והבושה = תשובה; מתנה = שבת; נדיבי העם IS teshuvah. The entire cluster expresses the single reality: returning to God in fear and shame IS eternal life IS the gift of Shabbat IS the ultimate spiritual delight. בושה (shame/awe) and חפרוה are the experiential face of the same teshuvah reality: the verse 'וחפרה הלבנה ובושה החמה' uses חפרוה as bechina of בושה, and בושה is the inner mechanism of teshuvah throughout this Torah.

merge_notes.reason: חפרוה IS bechina of בושה, drawn from the verse 'וחפרה הלבנה ובושה החמה' (Isa 24:23). They are two expressions of the same experience of shame/humility-awe. בושה is not connected to תשובה via bechina in the dataset (only via eitza), but the two-node component (חפרוה ↔ בושה) belongs unmistakably to the teshuvah domain: the entire Torah declares that בושה IS the mechanism of תשובה. Importantly, the test is shared NATURE not cause-effect: both חפרוה and בושה express the experience of shame-before-God, which is the same quality as the יראה-והבושה node already in this package.

packages.label: שִׁפְלוּת וְאַיִן
packages.reason: These concepts share the essential nature of limitlessness through self-nullification. שפלות ועניוות IS בלתי גבול (without limit) because it IS אין (nothingness). This is the Torah's foundational teaching about humility: only that which has no ego-boundary (אין) can receive the infinite pleasure of the World to Come. מדבר (wilderness) = שפלות because one who makes oneself like a wilderness (without claims) achieves this quality of שפלות. The Torah declares: 'שפלות ועניוות הוא בחינת בלתי גבול, כי הוא בחינת אין ממש.' This whole cluster is about the single reality of true lowliness as infinite openness.

merge_notes.reason: מדבר IS bechina of שפלות: 'מדבר היינו שפלות, שמשים עצמו כמדבר.' These two form a two-node bechina pair. Their thematic home is unmistakably the שפלות cluster: מדבר is wilderness-humility, and שפלות is humility — they are both expressions of the same quality of self-nullification. The node שפלות and the node שפלות ועניוות share the same essential nature (שפלות ועניוות is simply a fuller form of the same concept), confirming the merge.

packages.label: בְּאֵר וּבֵאוּרֵי הַתּוֹרָה
packages.reason: The well (באר), the rock (סלע), and Torah explanations (באורי התורה / חידושין דאוריתא) share the essential nature of the vessel and spring from which the Tzaddik's Torah flows to his followers. The text: 'באר זה בחינת באורי התורה... סלע ישכן — זה הבאר.' The three are mutually equated: סלע = באר = באורי התורה, forming a triangle of bechina relationships. These are all symbolic vessels for the same reality: the Torah novelties that flow from the Tzaddik's universal intellect and produce shame and teshuvah in those who receive them.
